title: Sources tell senators of recovered and reverse-engineered craft

tellings.quote: Um yes. Uh uh these are people who uh found their way one way or another to us on Capitol Hill and met with uh with senators and who made precisely those kinds of claims.

plain: Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staff member, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that between about 2017 and 2024 people found their way to Capitol Hill and met with senators. He says they claimed that craft of unknown origin had been recovered and taken apart to learn how they work, which, if true, would mean such objects are held in secret.
